SamplingOverride.description:
A sampling rule for the PVs matching one glob.

Globs are ``fnmatch`` patterns over the full, lowercase PV name
(``undulator:u_vacuumgauge:*``).  The last matching override wins per
field.  At least one of ``sampling_period`` or ``sampling_method`` must be
given.  The values are sent to the appliance with the archive request
(its "user-specified sampling"), so what this file says is what the
appliance does — there is no second table of named policies to agree with.

match.description: fnmatch glob over the full lowercase PV name.
match.title: Match

sampling_period.description: Sampling period in seconds (the appliance's samplingperiod).
sampling_period.title: Sampling Period

sampling_method.description: MONITOR (store every change the appliance is sent; the period only sizes its buffer) or SCAN (store the latest value once per period).
sampling_method.title: Sampling Method

SamplingOverride.title: SamplingOverride

description: The experiment's archive-set exceptions and sampling defaults.

schema_version.description: Format version of this config file. Leave at 1 — tools update this automatically when the file format changes.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

exclude.description: fnmatch globs over full lowercase PV names that the derived rule would include but this experiment does not archive.
exclude.title: Exclude

include.description: Full PV names to archive beyond what the rule derives (e.g. a gateway diagnostic such as 'undulator:cagateway:uptime'). Listed PVs are never paused by onboarding; 'exclude' does not apply to them.
include.title: Include

include_setpoints.description: Archive the ':SP' setpoint PV of every settable variable. They change only on puts and carry the operator's intent and the refused-write alarm history.
include_setpoints.title: Include Setpoints

include_status.description: Archive every device's 'connected' status PV (state changes only) and the gateway's own heartbeat and devices_connected.
include_status.title: Include Status

include_derived.description: Archive the gateway's derived channels declared in the experiment's gateway/derived_channels.yaml.
include_derived.title: Include Derived

default_sampling_period.description: Sampling period (seconds) for PVs no override matches.
default_sampling_period.title: Default Sampling Period

default_sampling_method.description: Sampling method for PVs no override matches.
default_sampling_method.title: Default Sampling Method

sampling_overrides.description: Per-glob sampling rules; the last matching entry wins per field.
sampling_overrides.title: Sampling Overrides
